# Design 4.2 row 27: rules_ruby `rb_bundle` and bazelruby `ruby_bundle`,
# which run Bundler themselves beside the `Gemfile`.

=== .bazelversion
7.7.2
=== WORKSPACE
workspace(name = "app")

load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

http_archive(
    name = "rules_ruby",
    strip_prefix = "rules_ruby-0.4.1",
    url = "https://github.com/bazel-contrib/rules_ruby/releases/download/v0.4.1/rules_ruby-v0.4.1.tar.gz",
)

load("@rules_ruby//ruby:deps.bzl", "rb_bundle", "rb_register_toolchains")

rb_register_toolchains(version = "system")

rb_bundle(
    name = "bundle",
    gemfile = "//app:Gemfile",
)

load("@bazelruby_rules_ruby//ruby:deps.bzl", "rules_ruby_dependencies", "rules_ruby_select_sdk")

rules_ruby_dependencies()

rules_ruby_select_sdk(version = "3.0.2")

load("@bazelruby_rules_ruby//ruby:defs.bzl", "ruby_bundle")

ruby_bundle(
    name = "legacy_bundle",
    gemfile = "//:Gemfile",
    gemfile_lock = "//:Gemfile.lock",
)
=== Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"
=== Gemfile.lock
GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
=== app/Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"
=== app/Gemfile.lock
GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
=== app/BUILD.bazel
